about_the_game:
STEAL LIMBS. SWAP POWERS. CLEAN UP CARL'S MESS.

Welcome to SWAPMEAT – the fast-paced co-op roguelite shooter where every kill makes you stronger ... and stranger! Rip through alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts, and help Carl Rangus fix what’s broken. Rip through alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts, and become the ultimate corporate problem-solver.

WELCOME TO THE CORPORATE SLAUGHTERHOUSE

You’re the freshest SmartMeat™ scientist at Rangus Meats, a galaxy-spanning megacorp whose innovation and disruption may or may not have triggered a galactic crisis that infested worlds with hungry mutants and murderous robots.

Your job:

  • Drop onto hostile planets

  • Contain the spread (and collect samples)

  • Swap out your squishy parts in real time

  • Survive long enough to receive your employee evaluation

Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers — triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching heads, and many more. Build yourself into the ultimate corporate solution, one ethically questionable upgrade at a time.

CORE FEATURES

Swap on the Fly

  • Rip, swap, and mutate mid-combat. Build your masterpiece (or disaster) one part at a time, adapting to every new threat.

Fast, Fluid Combat

  • Tight, skill-based gunplay inspired by Risk of Rain 2 and Helldivers 2. Dodge, shoot, and swap your way through escalating chaos while meeting your “containment targets.”

Built for Co-Op (1–4 Players)

  • Solo or squad, coordinate limb loadouts and synergize abilities with your coworkers. Shared upgrades and evolving builds reward teamwork — and make for spectacular failures when things go wrong.

Roguelite Replayability

  • Each mission throws new enemies, random events, and unexpected part combinations at you. No two runs, or bodies, are ever the same.

Absurd Alien Worlds

  • From meat moons to fungal cities and rogue AI factories, explore a galaxy of strange ecosystems, hostile factions, and questionable workplace safety practices.

Permanent Upgrades Between Runs

  • Bring your “research” back to HQ and cash it in for weapon unlocks, new perks, and company-approved “self-improvements.”

Wishlist SWAPMEAT now to keep up with the chaos leading into launch, and join our Meat Lab playtests to make the galaxy safer, stranger, and just a little more profitable.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux Kernel 5
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 380 / Nvidia GTX 960
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux Kernel 6
  • Processor: 3.00 Ghz Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 / Nvidia GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
